summary: Borealis Foods Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiaries entered into a $17.0 million term loan credit agreement with Oxus Capital PTE Ltd., the former SPAC sponsor and significant shareholder. Proceeds repaid $16.2 million under the existing Frontwell credit facility, with remainder used for expenses and working capital. The loan matures in April 2031, bears 12% interest, and is secured by substantially all assets, including real estate. Monthly principal payments begin May 2027. This is a related-party refinancing, not a transformative special situation; watch for ongoing related-party dealings.
